finding: A network clock prior is negligible with a full sky but decisive under obstruction: at 3-5 visible satellites it removes the clock/vertical degeneracy that makes instantaneous PPP rank-deficient or >10 m. This is the real-time / urban-canyon operational niche; batch 24 h phase PPP does not need it (Step 23). Overhead is 2 scalar operations per epoch.
